 E. ईश, and अण् aff.

ऐशानी f. (-नी) The north-east quarter.
 E. ईशान ŚIVA, as regent of the
north-east, अण् and ङीष् affs.

ऐषमस् ind. The present year.
 E. इदम् this, समसण् aff.

ऐषमस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or belonging to the present year. E.
ऐषमस्, and त्यय affix; or with द्यु affix, ऐषमस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं.)
